pages.title: Rajya Sabha panel of Vice-Chairpersons reconstituted

facts.text: Effective April 15, 2026; nominated by Chairman C.P. Radhakrishnan — six members: Dinesh Sharma, S. Phangnon Konyak, Ghanshyam Tiwari, Phulo Devi Netam, M. Thambidurai, Sasmit Patra
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Art 83: RS members 6-year term; one-third retire every 2 years

pages.title: Privilege notice against PM by K.C. Venugopal

facts.text: Congress MP K.C. Venugopal gave privilege notice against PM Narendra Modi over remarks on opposition MPs during voting on bills
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Art 105 (MPs) and Art 194 (State legislators) — privileges; Arts 122, 212 bar courts on procedural irregularities
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Rule 187 (Lok Sabha), Rule 222 (Rajya Sabha)
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Privileges Committee: 15 members (LS), 10 (RS)
facts.head: Key facts

pages.title: Nyaya Setu AI chatbot and mascot Dishika

facts.text: Launched by Vice President and Law Minister under DISHA programme — Nyaya Setu AI legal assistant; mascot Dishika
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Voice-first, multilingual; built on Digital India Bhashini (ASR, NLP); trained on Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Bhashini — 2022, MeitY; BNS in force July 1, 2024; Law Minister Arjun Ram Meghwal; Art 39A (free legal aid)
facts.head: Key facts

pages.title: Justice Yashwant Varma resigns before impeachment

facts.text: Allahabad HC judge Justice Yashwant Varma resigned to the President before impeachment proceedings advanced
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Linked to March 14, 2025 recovery of burnt cash at his residence during Delhi HC tenure
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: ⚠ Resignation lets him keep pension and benefits (lost if removed)
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Removal: Arts 124(4), 124(5), 217 — special majority in both Houses, then President's order
facts.head: Key facts

pages.title: Online Gaming Authority of India set up

facts.text: Six-member authority, chaired by an Additional Secretary (MeitY); members — JSs of Home, I&B, Youth Affairs, Financial Services, Law
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Classifies games, registers, approves money games, grievance redressal
